tool_args.rationale: The initial rows show positive gain only for H=0.16–0.48, while the target horizon is 24.3. The recalled dual-horizon mechanisms predict reversal only at long horizons, so a slow-horizon observation is necessary to identify the relevant behavior before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at short horizons and lack variation in x_now, mem_conv, and s_grad; they cannot identify long-horizon reversal or distinguish the sink-coupled model.
More short-horizon data would not resolve the key uncertainty at the target horizon H=24.3.
It is explicitly irrelevant and would not discriminate the candidate mechanisms.
